name: Sekolah Al Ma'soem Jatinangor
address: Jl. Raya Cipacing No.22, Jatinangor, Kabupaten Sumedang

notes.id: Program full day. Biaya masuk Rp9.400.000 belum termasuk seragam dan buku Rp1.500.000 (total Rp10.900.000). SPP belum termasuk katering.
notes.en: Full-day programme. Entry Rp9,400,000 excluding uniforms and books Rp1,500,000 (total Rp10,900,000). Tuition excludes catering.

source.title: Biaya Masuk SD di Bandung [Update 2026] (blog Armita Fibri)

notes.id: Total biaya masuk per gelombang (termasuk registrasi Rp730.000 dan DPP dengan keringanan berbeda): gelombang 1 Rp12.985.000; gelombang 2 Rp13.640.000; gelombang 3 Rp14.295.000; gelombang 4 Rp14.950.000; extra gelombang Rp15.605.000 (keringanan DPP 0%). Seragam dan buku dapat dihitung terpisah.
notes.en: Total entry cost by wave (incl. Rp730,000 registration and the DPP with different discounts): wave 1 Rp12,985,000; wave 2 Rp13,640,000; wave 3 Rp14,295,000; wave 4 Rp14,950,000; extra wave Rp15,605,000 (no DPP discount). Uniforms and books may be extra.

source.title: Berapa Biaya Masuk SD Al Ma'soem Bandung TA 2027–2028 (situs resmi Yayasan Al Ma'soem)

notes.id: Total biaya masuk SMA reguler: gelombang 1 Rp19.500.000 (DPP -20%, mulai 1 Agustus 2026); gelombang 2 Rp20.525.000 (Oktober 2026); gelombang 3 Rp21.550.000 (Januari 2027); gelombang 4 Rp22.575.000 (April 2027); extra gelombang Rp23.600.000. Kelas internasional mulai sekitar Rp23.885.000.
notes.en: Total SMA entry cost (regular): wave 1 Rp19,500,000 (DPP −20%, from 1 August 2026); wave 2 Rp20,525,000 (October 2026); wave 3 Rp21,550,000 (January 2027); wave 4 Rp22,575,000 (April 2027); extra wave Rp23,600,000. International class from about Rp23,885,000.
